name: Pillar
all_locations: New York City, NY, USA; Remote
long_description: Pillar was founded to integrate health education and behavior change support into everyday care. The company partnered with 29 healthcare organizations to power digital coaching and clinical programs ranging from preventative health and chronic disease management to expert-in-the-loop AI evaluation. Partners included Amazon One Medical, Samsung Health, Quest Diagnostics and digital health unicorns. Through this work, Pillar emerged as a leader in the health coaching space with peer-reviewed research published in the American Journal of Lifestyle Medicine and an industry report presented at the American College of Lifestyle Medicine.
one_liner: Integrating health coaching into everyday care
